+import argparse
+import time
+
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.ep_moe.kernels import pre_reorder_triton_kernel
+
+
+def run_once(batch, hidden, topk, experts, shard_start, shard_end, dtype):
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    x = torch.randn(batch, hidden, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+    topk_ids = torch.randint(0, experts, (batch, topk), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    # dst index layout matches the sorted layout of each token's top-k
+    src2dst = torch.arange(batch * topk, device=device, dtype=torch.int32).view(batch, topk)
+    a1_scales = torch.randn(shard_end - shard_start + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    gateup = torch.empty(batch * topk, hidden, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+
+    BLOCK = 128
+    grid = (batch,)
+    pre_reorder_triton_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        gateup,
+        src2dst,
+        topk_ids,
+        a1_scales,
+        shard_start,
+        shard_end,
+        topk,
+        hidden,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK,
+    )
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device) if device.type == "cuda" else None
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2048)
+    parser.add_argument("--hidden", type=int, default=4096)
+    parser.add_argument("--topk", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--experts", type=int, default=64)
+    parser.add_argument("--shard-size", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--dtype", type=str, default="float16", choices=["float16", "bfloat16", "float32"]) 
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=50)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    dtype = getattr(torch, args.dtype)
+    shard_start = 0
+    shard_end = min(args.experts - 1, args.shard_size - 1)
+
+    for _ in range(args.warmup):
+        run_once(args.batch, args.hidden, args.topk, args.experts, shard_start, shard_end, dtype)
+
+    torch.cuda.synchronize() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
+    t0 = time.time()
+    for _ in range(args.iters):
+        run_once(args.batch, args.hidden, args.topk, args.experts, shard_start, shard_end, dtype)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
+    t1 = time.time()
+    latency = (t1 - t0) / args.iters * 1000
+    print(f"batch={args.batch} hidden={args.hidden} topk={args.topk} latency={latency:.3f} ms")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+
